title: St. Vincent–St. Mary vs. VASJ — Football (2025–2026)
summary: St. Vincent–St. Mary Fighting Irish vs. Villa Angela–St. Joseph Vikings — football coverage. Photography by Mason Bybee.
article_headline: St. Vincent–St. Mary vs. VASJ: Northeast Ohio Football
article_dek: A sideline photo essay featuring the Fighting Irish and Vikings.
article_body:
St. Vincent–St. Mary and Villa Angela–St. Joseph are two Northeast Ohio school programs with their own sporting identities. Their football matchup provides a setting for athletes to compete and represent their communities.

This archive follows the players through Mason Bybee’s field-level images. It keeps the attention on the action and does not reconstruct an unverified final score.
